text:
incident-bot: ALERT: CDN POP LAX egress error rate spike / partial path blackholing detected (auto-escalation threshold). service: cdn-edge, impact: client 5xx -> +18% over baseline, started 2024-11-02T02:01:28Z

alice_ops: seeing 502/504s from multiple customers hitting LAX POP. Dashboards show egress latency + packet drops on LAX->carrierA links.

ben_net: confirmed — sFlow/ifCounters show TX error bursts on xe-0/1/2 of leaf-lax-agg. Might be carrier-facing egress congestion or transient PIC drop.

carla_support: multiple customer reports: "uploads failing", "static assets 502". Ticket spike in the last 6m. CX impact moderate, flagging >10 paying customers.

dave_oncall: I'm on it. Can someone post the most recent pcap/flow slice and the affected prefixes?

ben_net: prefix list: 34.120.0.0/18, 54.234.0.0/16 -> these are the CDN egress ranges from LAX. Attached sample flow: "dst=carrierA, src=cdn-lax-edge02, drops=1200, qlen=4096".

frank_sre: quick mitigation options: 1) quiesce LAX egress to carrierA and steer to carrierB (fast), 2) withdraw/announce more-specifics from SJC/SEA to attract traffic (requires BGP ops), 3) contact carrierA support for immediate handoff.

alice_ops: we should steer at the CDN layer first — we can flip origin/egress policy for affected POP to prefer carrierB in 60s. If that fails, escalate to cross-POP announce.

carla_support: notifying top-tier customers in affected regions with an incident blurb now. ETA on mitigation? Customers asking for timeline.

dave_oncall: starting CDN egress steering play (runbook: /runbooks/cdn/egress-steer). Command: `rb scripts/steer_pop.py --pop lax --prefer carrierB --dry-run=false`

frank_sre: running dry-run first: logs show policy compile ok. Executing now.

incident-bot: ACTION: egress-steer job kicked by dave_oncall at 2024-11-02T02:08:12Z. Job id: steer-2175008888-1.

ben_net: after steer: carrierB uptake ~70% within 90s, carrierA traffic down 65%. Packet drops drop to baseline on LAX->carrierB.

carla_support: note to customers: partial recovery observed; continue monitoring. Sending updated blurb. :thumbsup:

elaine_pm: are we seeing any cache misses/latency regressions from steering? Don’t want to trade 5xx for tail latency regressions.

frank_sre: tail p90 increased ~40ms for assets routed via carrierB, p50 unchanged. No dramatic error spike. Overall error rate down to +4% vs baseline.

dave_oncall: good. We'll keep steering in place while we validate carrierA with them. Ben, can you open a ticket with carrierA and request PoP engineering to check the egress path? Include sFlow and timestamps.

ben_net: ticket opened with carrierA (case 892134). They report interface errors consistent with microburst/queue-drop and are investigating config on their egress router.

incident-bot: NOTE: paging dave_oncall -> frank_sre for handoff at 02:15 UTC.

frank_sre: I'll take over for the next hour to track remediation and rollback plan. Handoff notes: steering applied, carrierB carrying majority traffic, ticket with carrierA open.

carla_support: follow-up sent to impacted customers with mitigation details and expected next update in 30m.

ben_net: carrierA reported misconfiguration on their egress shaping causing queue starvation under short bursts — they are applying a patch and will monitor for 20m.

frank_sre: plan: keep pop steering to carrierB until carrierA confirms stable for 30m of low-drop telemetry. If carrierA not stable by 02:40 UTC, escalate to cross-POP announces (SJC/SEA) as fallback.

elaine_pm: flagging possible postmortem if >30 customers affected or >60m total impact.

incident-bot: REMINDER: next update requested in 20 minutes.

carla_support: updated customers at 02:20 UTC: "We’ve applied temporary traffic steering. Some requests may see slightly higher latency; errors have substantially decreased."

ben_net: carrierA reports fixes deployed at 02:26 UTC, monitoring. I’m seeing drops trending toward baseline but still occasional blips.

frank_sre: beginning controlled rollback of egress-steer (reverse command): `rb scripts/steer_pop.py --pop lax --prefer carrierA --dry-run=false --rate-limit 10` — doing gradual shift to avoid re-trigger.

incident-bot: ACTION: rollback job kicked by frank_sre at 2024-11-02T02:29:10Z. Job id: steer-2175008888-rollback-1.

dave_oncall: monitoring customer errors as we shift.

ben_net: after 10% shift back to carrierA — no spike. After 40% — small blip visible but within threshold.

carla_support: update sent at 02:33 UTC: "Traffic returned to normal routing. Carrier issue resolved. Please reach out if you see ongoing errors."

frank_sre: closing remediation loop. Opening incident tracking ticket (INC-2024-112) for postmortem and RCA. Assigning owners: net (ben_net), ops (alice_ops), support (carla_support).

elaine_pm: thanks team. Will coordinate postmortem and customer outreach draft.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. End of thread."
